tasks.subject: Task 5: Cargo registry + git cache across workflows
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `actions/cache@v4` for `~/.cargo/registry/{index,cache}` + `~/.cargo/git/db` in every cargo-touching job, keyed on Cargo.lock.

See plan doc Task 5.

```json:metadata
{"files":[".github/workflows/release.yml",".github/workflows/ci.yml",".github/workflows/host-tools.yml"],"verifyCommand":"python3 -c \"import yaml, glob\nfor path in glob.glob('.github/workflows/*.yml'):\n  wf = yaml.safe_load(open(path))\n  for jn, j in wf.get('jobs', {}).items():\n    s = str(j.get('steps', []))\n    if 'cargo' in s.lower() and not ('actions/cache' in s and '~/.cargo/registry' in s): print(f'MISSING: {path}::{jn}')\nprint('done')\"","acceptanceCriteria":["every cargo job has cache","key keyed on Cargo.lock","restore-keys fallback","no target/ in cache"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Concurrency groups in all workflows
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Force-pushes cancel stale runs on feature branches; main never cancelled.

See plan doc Task 6.

```json:metadata
{"files":[".github/workflows/release.yml",".github/workflows/ci.yml",".github/workflows/host-tools.yml"],"verifyCommand":"python3 -c \"import yaml, glob\nfor path in glob.glob('.github/workflows/*.yml'):\n  c = yaml.safe_load(open(path)).get('concurrency')\n  assert c and c.get('group') == '\\${{ github.workflow }}-\\${{ github.ref }}'\nprint('done')\"","acceptanceCriteria":["every workflow has top-level concurrency","group = workflow-ref","cancel-in-progress excludes main","YAML valid"]}
```
